action_items: Reminder: PROSPER_DISABLE_RATELIMIT=1 in /app/backend/.env must be REMOVED for staging/prod deploys (currently kept for preview tests — already documented in review_request).

(Already-known, non-blocking) Pre-existing failures in test_phase2/3/5/9_extras are data-count drift from shared seed pollution across iterations — NOT Phase 12 regressions. Worth a baseline seed reset before promoting to staging.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_ops.seed_demo_client mixes a deterministic suffix (token_hex(3) = 6 hex chars) into both org_id AND user_id AND email domain. Collision probability ~1/16M is fine, but for an audit-friendly trail consider a monotonic counter or longer suffix.

admin_ops.seed_demo_client seeds tx_hash='DEMO_TX_HASH_<SUFFIX>' on the subscribe tx — relies on sparse index uniqueness NOT being enforced (sparse, non-unique). Confirmed the db.py index is sparse-only (not unique), so multiple demo seeds won't collide.

/api/v1/status endpoint re-creates a Redis client connection on every poll (every 30s from /status page × N clients). For preview that's negligible but in prod recommend a memoized aioredis singleton or status cache with 5s TTL.

rate_limit() uses a module-level in-memory dict (_rate_buckets) — per worker only. With Gunicorn workers > 1 the effective per-IP limit becomes per_min × workers. Consider Redis-backed token bucket for prod (mentioned in RUNBOOK is recommended).

Status overall='degraded' is currently driven exclusively by Redis. If Redis is *expected* to be absent in preview, consider treating its 'degraded' as 'optional' so overall stays 'operational' when only optional services are degraded — purely cosmetic for the public status page.
